none: PAS BM-E1DB0C: BM-E1DB0C: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the second or third century AD. The sealing is oval in shape and hemispherical in section. White and brown discolouration/corrosion products at each end of the oval sealing suggests the presence of a cord and perforations, although the latter is not visible.
